text:
Maya: Quick drop  draft roadmap slice for routing + multi-region isolation: three lanes (pilot, affinity, residency). Goals: clear gates, rollback playbooks, and GTM readiness.

Ravi: Can we map lanes to offering? pilot = self-serve Hosted, affinity = sales-assisted Hosted, residency = Dedicated/Private.

Sam: Agree. Add evacuation/rollback checklist per lane. Keep it prescriptive: owner, order, and fallback policy.

Lina: Sales needs a 2-bullet checklist per lane (promise + what we monitor). Also an "isolation readiness" score (5 binary checks -> 0-100).

Maya: Proposed gates for affinity alpha: p95 < 300ms in-region, tracing + audit logs enabled, committed capacity documented.

Jesse: I'll compile customer-fit matrix (who needs affinity vs residency) and share by EOD Fri.

Ravi: Infra wants a minimal policy DSL: preferred_region, failover_chain, tenant_quota, enforcement_mode. Infra owns runtime; product owns semantics and tests.

Sam: Implementation note: start with passive signals (headers + metrics) then add enforcement in residency pilot.

Maya: Milestones: M1 = affinity alpha (8w) routing primitives + observability. M2 = residency pilot (enforcement + billing flow).

Lina: Action items: Jesse -> customer matrix; Ravi+Sam -> DSL sketch + rollback plan; Lina -> GTM checklist + readiness def; Maya -> consolidate PRD.

Maya: I'll post PRD link when ready. Ping for reviews.
